items.title: Influencer, humanitarian, AI fake: Untangling the Lily Jay Foundation
items.description: Receiving millions of views online, the Lily Jay Foundation claims to help children across the world. She was even given an award for her work. But what is real and what is AI-generated? ABC NEWS Verify investigates.

items.title: 'Horrified' First Guardian and Shield investors consider class action
items.description: Investors who lost out in a superannuation scam are considering a potential class action.

items.title: Australia's spy agency turns to Vogue to find recruits
items.description: A security industry insider tells the ABC the agency cannot afford to "just hire dweebs" as ASIS pivots to a new recruitment strategy aimed at women.

items.title: How the Trump era echoes the messy truth behind the founding of America
items.description: US Independence Day was never the simple morality tale Americans often tell themselves. Under Donald Trump the debate over its meaning is more politically charged than ever under.

items.title: Simon Carman's life before alleged murder of Thai teenager
items.description: Accused murderer Simon Peter Carman spent much of the past decade isolating himself from many of his friends and family in Australia. It's in his rented room in Thailand that local police allege a gruesome murder occurred.

items.title: 'The world lost him': Crowds gather in Iran to farewell body of assassinated supreme leader
items.description: Millions of Iranians have gathered in Tehran as the country begins a week of funeral ceremonies for former supreme leader, Ayatollah Ali Khamenei.

items.title: First case of deadly H5N1 bird flu confirmed in NSW
items.description: The first case of the deadly H5 bird flu is confirmed in a giant petrel found on the NSW Mid North Coast.

items.title: Meta bans millions of accounts as AI impersonates real creators
items.description: Alicia discovered a Facebook account had gained more than 500,000 followers by posting AI-generated images of her.

items.title: In the iPad age, how has Play School stayed relevant to our kids?
items.description: Australian Story is given rare behind-the-scenes access to Play School as it celebrates 60 years on air. An intimate look at the creative process of the iconic children’s TV show that’s still guided by one golden rule.

items.title: Thunderbirds unlock Super Netball dynasty with unique coaching approach
items.description: The Adelaide Thunderbirds have unlocked a Super Netball dynasty with a unique coaching approach under Tania Obst. The three-time Super Netball champions defeated the Melbourne Vixens 61- 40 in the grand final at John Cain Arena.

items.title: Magpie Maynard makes contact with umpire after being hit 'cheaply'
items.description: Collingwood defender Brayden Maynard could be in trouble after making contact with an umpire during the Magpies' six-point win over the Gold Coast Suns.

items.title: Live: Desperate Canada on the brink after double Morocco strike
items.description: World Cup co-hosts Canada look for a spot in the last eight as they take on Morocco, while surprise-packets Paraguay take on hot-favourites France. Follow live.

items.title: Broncos cop eighth straight loss as Sharks get home at Lang Park
items.description: The battling Broncos lose their eighth straight game, going down 28-16 to the Sharks at Lang Park after the Dragons got just their second win of the season against the Tigers.

items.title: Knee 'tweak' ends Serena Williams Wimbledon comeback
items.description: Serena Williams has pulled out of her Wimbledon doubles campaign alongside sister Venus, after sustaining a knee injury during her opening-round singles defeat to Australia's Maya Joint.

items.title: App fatigue can 'warp' dating but there's an antidote
items.description: Dating apps promised more choice than ever, but experts say the endless swiping and split-second decisions may be leaving users more exhausted, and less connected, than before. But deleting them may not be the only solution.

items.title: It's time for your weekly spelling check-up
items.description: Will those primary school spelling sheets be enough to pull you a pass?

items.title: As NAIDOC turns 50, what is 'deadly' and what does it mean to you?
items.description: As official NAIDOC celebrations get underway across the country, the ABC's Matt Francis asks what is deadly and what does it mean to the Indigenous community across the country.

items.title: Trump made money off his meme coin, did its investors?
items.description: US President Donald Trump made huge amounts of money from his family's crypto and meme coin ventures last year, but did his investors?

items.title: Are America's founding principles being challenged?
items.description: The United States is celebrating its 250th anniversary today. Let's take a closer look at the document that birthed the nation and where things stand now.

items.title: The rumours and speculation around Taylor Swift's wedding
items.description: Singer Taylor Swift has married footballer Travis Kelce, creating a massive pop culture moment and a passionate talking point on social media.

items.title: Footballer critical after sustaining head injury during match
items.description: A 27-year-old player is in a critical condition after a serious mid-match injury during a football game in Lalor this afternoon.

items.title: Ukraine retaliates, striking St Petersburg following deadliest attack
items.description: Ukraine has retaliated after Russia's attack on Kyiv killed at least 27 people.

items.title: Two Sydney Mardi Gras board members removed after months of disputes
items.description: Damien Nguyen and Luna Choo from Pride in Protest were voted off the Sydney Gay and Lesbian Mardi Gras board by a 70 per cent majority.

items.title: Government rejects all UN recommendations on LGBTQIA+ rights
items.description: The Albanese government has accepted the lowest number of recommendations made by the UN Human Rights Council in 20 years, with none protecting the LGBTQIA+ community.

items.title: As thin crowds at Trump's fair go viral, Americans reflect on July 4
items.description: Donald Trump has been pushing a patriotic message ahead of a July 4 milestone, but some Americans say they feel no national pride at this point in their country's history.
